verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: hashtag badge, then a dominant '6 SYMPTOMS', then the list, doctor and CTA, so the hierarchy holds. But the symptom list is tiny and badly wrapped ('Sore throat Headache' merged on one line), and the doctor has shrunk to a cramped thumbnail beside the CTA. B shrinks the headline under a left-hand yellow block, jams the tiny CTA right against the symptom list so they nearly collide, and leaves the right third of the banner empty, making it lopsided and the CTA buried.
